reviews.title: Potencia y conectividad de última generación
reviews.comment: Placa base muy completa para equipos modernos. Compatible con DDR5 y PCIe 5.0, ofrece gran rendimiento y preparación a futuro. Destacan sus múltiples M.2, WiFi 6E y LAN 2.5Gb. Instalación sencilla y buena estabilidad. Ideal para gaming y productividad exigente.
reviews.author: Alexander Orozco

reviews.title: Fantastic Motherboard
reviews.comment: This is another great ASUS Motherboard.  Very quick and easy build using this board with the Ryzen CPU.  Lots of USB ports, lots of expansion headers and the heatsinks on the control chips are great.  I only have a couple of obstacles that had to be overcome using this board.  First, there is no speaker or speaker connector on this board.  Second, the space between the memory and the CPU is a little tight so be aware of that when you are selecting a CPU cooler.  Your CPU cooling fan may end up sitting on top of your memory if your memory has ARGB on it - easy enough to overcome but it slowed an otherwise lightning build down for a while.  Lots of support, 3 NvMe slots for solid state storage.  This is a lot of bang for the buck.  And performance speed?  FAST.  A great choice for gaming or power computing.
reviews.author: Fletch
